claim: SKILL.md authoring: SKILL.md is the orchestrator, not the encyclopedia. New skills must target <=200 lines; existing/exceptional skills <=500 lines. Long templates, examples, anti-patterns, detailed workflows, and eval checklists belong in modular files under instructions/, examples/, references/, templates/, scripts/, eval/. Read the repo skill architecture guide before changing authoring rules.

decisions.notes: Recorded 2026-07-04 planning session. Dogfoods the concise modular architecture the system itself teaches.
